text: a repo without the shim is not gated (red if the gate is not opt-in)
why: Opt-in is the absence of any global install path: git runs the hook only from a repo's hooks dir, and nothing but proof-hooks-install.py --install writes one. No patch to the hook or installer can gate an un-shimmed repo short of writing global git config, which the suite isolates (GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, --template=). The suite's 'repo without the shim commits freely' case asserts it.
